prompt: WHITE-LINE WOOD ENGRAVING / scratchboard illustration. The image is SOLID BLACK, and every form is revealed by FINE WHITE CARVED LINES cut out of that black — dense parallel line shading, stippling, contour cuts that follow the shape of each object, radiating cut lines where light falls. No grey washes, no gradients, no soft glow: only black, white carved line, and ONE accent of SATURATED WARM GOLD used exclusively for light sources. Bold graphic composition, high contrast, hand-cut irregularity. No text, no lettering, no signage, no runes. Night, close view: one small cabin among towering grass and dripping fern, carved in white line on black. In its single window a FLAT GOLD rectangle of lamplight, and seated in that window one small being — a solid black silhouette with a fine carved white rim-light along its back and ears — holding up a single trading card almost as tall as itself, examining it against the lamp so the card glows gold in its hands. Everything else black and white carved line: wet leaves, a pebble step, a fallen seed pod.
